A yellow ice cream cone held at the bottom edge of frames two through four is within the camera wearer's arm's reach and partly cropped out of view, while in frame four another person's blurred head briefly enters the extreme lower-left foreground within 0.5 m, partially occluding the seated person. By the fifth frame, the person in the white t-shirt turns completely around to face and walk toward the camera wearer at a distance of about 1.5 m, while the masked kiosk worker remains about 3 m away behind the counter, partially occluded by the counter and display case.
